title: Jorja Smith Announces International Artist Presale for the What Are The Odds Tour
summary: Jorja Smith is taking What Are The Odds on the road across the UK, Europe and Australia. Ahead of the tour, fans can register for an artist presale powered by Laylo’s RealFan technology to deliver unique codes.
body_markdown:
Jorja Smith has been one of the most distinctive voices in British music since "Blue Lights" broke out in 2016, a run that took in a Mercury-nominated debut in *Lost & Found* , the BRIT Award for British Female Solo Artist, and a stretch on Drake's *More Life* .


Her latest album, *What Are The Odds,* just dropped, and she is taking it global, with dates across EU/UK and Australia.


Fans get first access[through an artist presale](https://laylo.com/jorjasmith/m/CGxpth) designed to keep tickets with real fans rather than bots and brokers. Registration opened on Friday, 8/21 and closes Monday, August 24 at 6 pm BST. Registration does not guarantee a ticket.


The presale is powered by[Laylo’s RealFan technology](https://laylo.com/features/anti-broker) , which uses unique, one-time codes to keep bots and resale activity out of presales and ensure more tickets go directly to fans.


## 🎟️ How to Get Jorja Smith Presale Tickets


Every fan who registers their phone number and verifies with 2FA will receive their own individual code by text. That is what keeps bots and brokers out and gives real fans a fair shot.


Here’s everything you need to know, whether you’re registering in the UK, Europe or Australia.


## 🇬🇧🇪🇺 UK and Europe


**1. Sign up for the presale**


Registration is open from Friday, August 21 to **Monday, August 24 at 6pm BST** . RSVP[here](https://laylo.com/jorjasmith/m/CGxpth) and complete the verification steps via SMS or email. If you do not finish verification, you will not receive a code. If you do not register before 6pm BST on Monday, August 24, you will not receive a code for the presale.


If you have a Denmark or Sweden phone number, you may need to register via email rather than text.


After you RSVP, you can explore Jorja's Townsend store, where you can pre-order *What Are The Odds.*


**2. Watch for your unique code**


Fans who registered will receive a confirmation text or email, and then a separate message with their unique code. Codes go out **Tuesday, August 25, end of day UK and EU time** , so you have the evening to find yours before presale morning.


**3. Have your code ready when the presale opens**


The presale opens **Wednesday, August 26 at 10am local time** . You will get a message on email or SMS pointing you back to Jorja's ticket link page, where you will:


- Select your show
- Enter your unique code
- Join the ticketing queue


Codes are one-time use and tied to your phone number.


## 🇦🇺 Australia


If you’re registering for Australia, here’s what to know.


**1. Sign up for the presale**


Registration opens **Friday, August 21 at 12pm local Australian time**[here](https://laylo.com/jorjasmith/m/CGxpth) . Complete the SMS verification steps, or you will not receive a code. Registration closes on Monday, August 24.


**2. Watch for your unique code**


Fans who registered will receive a confirmation text or email, and then a separate message with their unique code.


**3. Use your code when the presale opens**


The presale opens Wednesday, August 26 at 10AM local time. You will get a message pointing you back to Jorja's tour page, where you will select your show, enter your code, and join the ticketing queue.


## ⚠️ Important Presale Details


- You must register before your region's deadline to receive a code
- No purchase is necessary to receive a code
- Codes cannot be shared or reused
- Codes are one-time use and tied to your phone number
- Registration does not guarantee tickets. Availability is limited.


## ❓ Presale FAQ


**Why is Jorja using unique codes?**
Unique codes limit brokers and resale activity so real fans get a better chance at tickets. On a recent artist presale run this way, over 100,000 bot and scalper signups were blocked before codes went out.


**I'm in Australia. Do the UK dates apply to me?**
No. Australia has its own registration deadline, code send time, and presale open. They are in the Australia section above.


**What if I don't receive a unique code?**
Codes go out the day before your region's presale. If you do not have one by presale morning, it likely means you did not complete the 2-step verification (2FA) when you RSVP'd. If you signed up via SMS, make sure you followed all registration steps. Reach out tocontact@laylo.com for any additional questions.


**What happens if my code doesn't work?**
Your code comes by text message from Laylo once you’ve verified using 2FA. That is the only code that will work. If you are trying to use the verification code you got when you first signed up, that is a different code, and it will not work at the presale.


If you receive your code by email and are having issues, reach out to Laylo at the email below.


**Who do I contact?**


- **Registration and codes** — Laylo, atcontact@laylo.com
- **Pre-orders and the Townsend store** —[Shop music and merch](https://townsendmusic.store/products/artist/jorja-smith?srsltid=AfmBOooL7uil1FRVx4fhumD1_3-7-PNxhIJO76iPx8bRXkX1xxEStx2J)
- **Queues, seat maps, and completing your purchase** — Dice[Help Center](https://dicefm.zendesk.com/hc/en-gb)


## ✨ Don't Miss Out


This is Jorja's first run behind *What Are The Odds* , and tickets are expected to go fast. Register before your region's deadline, watch for your code the night before, and be ready when the presale opens.
